AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了在铁电体中实现光控定向电极化输运的途径。

title: Bond-valence theory is a general electrostatic valence rule
summary: Pauling's electrostatic valence rule assigns to each bond of a cation of charge $z$ with $n$ anion neighbors the strength $z/n$. Bond-valence theory replaces the equal split of valence among bonds by $s=\exp[(R_0-d)/B]$ in the bond length $d$ and takes the sum rule, that the valences at each atom add to its formal charge, as its first axiom. Here the bond valence is defined in the electron density. Atomic basins of a first-principles density are bounded by faces, one per bond critical point, and the electric flux of that density through a face is a charge associated with the bond. The fluxes leaving a cation sum to its basin charge by Gauss's law, so on this surface the sum rule is a theorem. Across 3680 oxides, halides, chalcogenides and pnictides the flux follows the bond-valence law site by site, with a median deviation of ten percent. The softness $B$ varies nearly an order of magnitude from stiff sulfides to softer arsenides. In all cases it is set by the electrostatic flux at atomic basin faces. $R_0$ then follows from the bond lengths and their differences. Anion valences equal those of bonded cations to within 5\% for most of the oxide, fluoride, sulfide and nitride sites. Transferability of $(R_0,B)$ between compounds fails in 96 of 106 families, suggesting that the softness is a local site property defined by the basin charge rather than a transferable constant of a given cation--anion pair. Eliminating $B$ by the sum rule gives $s=(z/n)^{(R_0-d)/(R_0-d_B)}$, Pauling's strength raised to a distance exponent at the softness-weighted mean bond length $d_B$. Thus, bond-valence theory is Pauling's rule with a distance exponent, and the electron density supplies the surface on which the two are equivalent.

AI.tldr: 论文把键价理论建立在第一性原理电子密度上：原子盆地面上的电场通量给出键电荷，使键价求和规则成为高斯定律的定理，并在大量化合物中验证通量遵循键价定律，最终表明键价理论是带距离指数的Pauling规则。
AI.motivation: Pauling静电价规则把阳离子电荷z均分给n个阴离子邻居，键价为z/n；键价理论则用s=exp[(R0-d)/B]的指数键长关系替代均分，并以各原子键价之和等于形式电荷为第一公理。论文旨在澄清二者关系，并寻找键价参数R0与B的电子密度物理来源及其可迁移性。
AI.method: 利用第一性原理电子密度构造原子盆地，每个键临界点对应一个原子盆地面；计算电子密度通过该面的电场通量，将其作为与该键相关的电荷。由Gauss定律，离开阳离子的通量之和等于其盆地电荷，因此在盆面上求和规则成为定理。随后在3680种氧化物、卤化物、硫族化物和磷族化物中逐位点检验通量是否服从键价定律，并分析B、R0、阴离子价及参数可迁移性。
AI.result: 在3680种化合物中，键通量逐位点遵循键价定律，中位偏差约10%。软度B从较硬的硫化物到较软的砷化物变化近一个数量级，并由原子盆面处的静电流决定；R0可由键长及其差异导出。多数氧化物、氟化物、硫化物和氮化物位点上，阴离子价与键合阳离子价在5%以内相符。然而(R0,B)在106个家族中有96个不能跨化合物迁移，说明B是由盆地电荷定义的局域位点性质，而非给定阳离子-阴离子对的普适常数。
AI.conclusion: 消去B后得到s=(z/n)^((R0-d)/(R0-d_B))，即在软度加权平均键长d_B处的距离指数修正的Pauling强度。因此键价理论可视为带距离指数的Pauling规则，而电子密度提供了二者等价成立的表面。

title: samQEq: universal charge equilibration for molecules and conductors
summary: Charge equilibration assigns atomic charges by equalizing an atomic chemical potential built from electronegativity, hardness and the Coulomb interaction. Under one global constraint it lets charge flow without limit between molecules, which fluctuating-charge models prevent with one neutrality constraint per molecule. A metal needs the opposite: a global constraint and a hardness near zero, and there the charge operator becomes indefinite unless it includes each charge's own self-energy. Here, we present samQEq (solids-and-molecules QEq), a unified charge-equilibration package for LAMMPS that combines the two constructions in one energy functional and one matrix-free solve. An orthogonal projector imposes one neutrality constraint per molecule, and the finite-width self-energy of a Gaussian charge on designated conductor types, narrower than the conductor's own Gaussian, keeps the conductor's part of the operator positive definite at any hardness. On a gold slab carrying a water film, the operator stays definite down to the conductor limit of the model, the metal screens a point charge by a constant amount at every height beyond 4 {\AA}, and the film's charges stay bounded under dynamics. Reciprocal-space electrostatics is evaluated inside the matrix-vector product, and three distinct shielding kernels are run-time settings. We verify the implementation by reproducing a published fluctuating-charge water model without refitting, and the native ReaxFF charge-equilibration step to approximately $10^{-9}\,e$. On a single four-V100 node the largest tested systems run at approximately twice the throughput of a 128-core CPU node. samQEq thus provides one charge-equilibration layer for molecules, conductors and the interfaces between them.

AI.tldr: 提出 samQEq：面向 LAMMPS 的统一电荷平衡方法，将分子中性约束与导体近零硬度极限整合在同一能量泛函和无矩阵求解中，实现分子、导体及其界面的电荷平衡。
AI.motivation: 传统电荷平衡在全局约束下允许分子间无限电荷转移，而涨落电荷模型用每分子中性约束限制转移；金属则需要全局约束和近零硬度，但若不含电荷自能，电荷算符会不定。需要统一处理分子、导体和界面。
AI.method: 在一个能量泛函和一次无矩阵求解中结合两类构造：用正交投影施加每分子一个中性约束；对指定导体类型引入比导体自身高斯更窄的有限宽度高斯自能，使导体部分算符在任意硬度下正定；倒空间静电在矩阵-向量积内计算，并提供三种可运行时设置的屏蔽核。
AI.result: 在金板加水膜体系中，算符在模型导体极限下保持正定，金属对点电荷在4 Å以上各高度产生恒定屏蔽，水膜电荷在动力学下保持有界；无需重拟合复现已发表涨落电荷水模型，并复现ReaxFF原生电荷平衡步至约1e-9 e；单节点4块V100吞吐约为128核CPU节点的2倍。
AI.conclusion: samQEq为分子、导体及其界面提供统一的电荷平衡层，并已作为LAMMPS软件包实现。

title: Surface chemistry as data for level-set simulation of etching and deposition
summary: Level-set simulators of etching and deposition move the surface with a velocity that depends on adsorbate coverages. These coverages are usually computed from balances solved and coded by hand for each chemistry, whereas voxel-based Monte Carlo profile simulators read the reaction mechanism as data. For the open-source level-set simulator ViennaPS, this work presents a surface model whose rate laws, Jacobian and velocity are derived from a reaction file and evaluated with ray-traced fluxes. Steady-state coverages are obtained with Newton's method and transient coverages with a conservative integrator. One compiled model is applied to eight chemistries for chemical vapour deposition, selective epitaxy, plasma etching, sputtering and atomic layer deposition. It reproduces a hand-written silicon etch model to seven significant digits at a single point and within the Monte Carlo noise in a masked trench. In a high-aspect-ratio cavity, alumina conformality is determined by a trimethylaluminium reaction probability within the measured range.

AI.tldr: 为 ViennaPS 提出数据驱动的表面模型：从反应文件自动生成速率律、Jacobian 与表面速度，用光线追踪通量评估，并以 Newton 法和保守积分器求稳态与瞬态覆盖度，一套模型覆盖八种工艺化学。
AI.motivation: 传统 level-set 刻蚀/沉积模拟器需针对每种化学手写并求解吸附质覆盖度平衡，复用性差；voxel-based Monte Carlo 则可直接将反应机理作为数据读取。
AI.method: 在开源 level-set 模拟器 ViennaPS 中，从反应文件推导速率律、Jacobian 和表面速度，并用 ray-traced fluxes 计算；稳态覆盖度用 Newton 法求解，瞬态覆盖度用保守积分器求解；一个编译模型应用于 CVD、选择性外延、等离子刻蚀、溅射和 ALD 八种化学。
AI.result: 与手写硅刻蚀模型在单点吻合至 7 位有效数字，并在掩膜沟槽中与 Monte Carlo 噪声范围内一致；在高深宽比腔体中，氧化铝保形性由测量范围内的 TMA 反应概率决定。
AI.conclusion: 该工作使 level-set 刻蚀/沉积模拟具备类似 voxel-based Monte Carlo 的反应机理数据驱动能力，并验证了跨多种化学与工艺的适用性。

title: Coexisting Kondo and Weyl-like transport in kagome heavy-fermion metal, Yb$_y$Co$_3$G$e_{3-x}$Sn$_x$
summary: Strong electron correlations and topology offer complementary routes to controlling electrical conduction, as correlations can make electrons heavy (e.g. Kondo lattices) whereas topology can make them behave as massless particles (e.g. Dirac or Weyl systems), and having both in one material is rare. In Kondo lattice systems, Kondo hybridization between localized 4$f$ and conduction electrons strongly enhances the quasiparticle mass, where in Weyl-Kondo systems these Kondo-renormalized bands form Weyl states, and simultaneous signs of both Kondo and Weyl states in one material have not been observed in transport. Here we report signs of both in the kagome metal \ce{Yb_yCo3Ge_{3-x}Sn_x} by combining magnetotransport, heat capacity, magnetization, angle-resolved and X-ray photoemission spectroscopy, and DFT+U calculations to reveal Yb-dependent Kondo scattering developing into lattice coherence, with extrapolated Sommerfeld coefficient of approximately 2 ~Jmol$_{\mathrm{Yb}}^{-1}$K$^{-2}$. Transverse magnetoresistance (MR) follows single-ion Kondo scaling, whereas longitudinal transport contains an additional negative response proportional to B$^2$ and remains unsaturated up to 32 T, consistent with a chiral anomaly. These findings support a picture of Kondo and Weyl-like conduction arising from distinct electronic states without external Fermi-level tuning, suggesting a possible route to combining correlated and topological functionality in a bulk material.

AI.tldr: 该文在kagome金属Yb_yCo3Ge_(3-x)Sn_x中结合磁输运、热容、磁化、ARPES/XPS与DFT+U计算，报道了Kondo关联与Weyl型拓扑传导共存的输运迹象。
AI.motivation: 强电子关联可使电子变重，拓扑可使电子表现为无质量粒子，但同一材料中同时观测到Kondo与Weyl态、尤其在输运中，仍很罕见；Weyl-Kondo体系缺乏同时输运证据。
AI.method: 对kagome金属Yb_yCo3Ge_(3-x)Sn_x进行磁输运、热容、磁化、角分辨光电子能谱、X射线光电子能谱和DFT+U计算，分析Yb依赖的Kondo散射、晶格相干性及纵向/横向磁阻行为。
AI.result: 观察到Yb依赖的Kondo散射发展为晶格相干，外推Sommerfeld系数约2 J mol_Yb^-1 K^-2；横向磁阻符合单离子Kondo标度，纵向输运另有正比于B^2的负响应，且在32 T下仍不饱和，与手征反常一致。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持Kondo传导与Weyl型传导来自不同电子态且无需外部费米能级调控，提示在块体材料中融合关联与拓扑功能的可能路径。

title: Bicarbonate/carbonic acid equilibria in aqueous solutions: Conformational Dynamics, Ion-Pair Speciation, and Free Energy Landscapes from Ab Initio Molecular Dynamics and Metadynamics
summary: Carbonic acid (H2CO3) is connected with the dissolved CO2 and bicarbonate (HCO3-) equilibria in aqueous solutions. Its two elementary reactions in water, acid dissociation and dehydration to CO2, are difficult to resolve because both are coupled to proton transfer through hydrogen-bonded networks. In this work, we combine 0.5 ns of unbiased PBE-D3 molecular dynamics of 1 molar solution of H2CO3 with metadynamics on the O - H coordination (H2CO3 = HCO3- + H+) and the C - O distance of the leaving hydroxyl (H2CO3 <=> CO2 + H2O). These unbiased trajectories show frequent cis-cis <=> cis-trans interconversion through long-lived bicarbonate (well separated from solvated proton, H3O+, and also mediated by a short-lived three-water [H2O...H3O+...H2O] ring that acts as a solvent-shared ion pair (SSIP); only 16-23% of deprotonation events reach a solvent-separated ion pair (SShIP). Resolving ion-pairs as SSIP for proper reaction leads to an improved estimate of pKa1 from 1.1 to 2.4, toward the experimental 3.45-3.59 (measured at supposedly infinite dilution). Further, metadynamics simulations provide a dehydration barrier of 17.8 (1D) and 15.3 kcal/mol (2D), suggesting that the final product CO2 + H2O is 2.8 kcal/mol below H2CO3. Our two-dimensional free energy surface also shows that C--O cleavage proceeds through the CO2 + OH- which further goes down by 9.9 kcal/mol to product CO2 + H2O.

AI.tldr: 该文结合无偏PBE-D3分子动力学与 metadynamics，解析水中碳酸（H2CO3）的酸解离与脱水到CO2两个耦合质子转移基本反应，并改进pKa1与脱水自由能垒估计。
AI.motivation: H2CO3的酸解离和脱水反应均与氢键网络中的质子转移耦合，导致反应机理和热力学/动力学量难以分辨，尤其离子对结构与pKa1估计存在偏差。
AI.method: 对1 M H2CO3水溶液进行0.5 ns无偏PBE-D3分子动力学，并针对O–H配位数（H2CO3 = HCO3− + H+）和离去羟基的C–O距离（H2CO3 ⇌ CO2 + H2O）开展metadynamics，构建一维和二维自由能面。
AI.result: 无偏轨迹显示cis-cis ⇌ cis-trans频繁互变，并涉及长寿命HCO3−及短寿命三水环[H2O...H3O+...H2O]构成的溶剂共享离子对（SSIP）；仅16–23%去质子化事件达到溶剂分离离子对（SShIP）。按SSIP正确解析反应后，pKa1由1.1改善至2.4，接近实验值3.45–3.59。Metadynamics给出脱水能垒17.8 kcal/mol（1D）和15.3 kcal/mol（2D），产物CO2 + H2O比H2CO3低2.8 kcal/mol；二维自由能面表明C–O断裂经由CO2 + OH−，并进一步以9.9 kcal/mol降至CO2 + H2O。
AI.conclusion: 离子对结构和显式溶剂介导的质子转移对H2CO3反应解析至关重要；考虑SSIP可显著改进pKa1估计，且脱水路径应通过二维自由能面描述，其中CO2 + OH−是相关中间态。

title: Why strong spin-orbit coupling does not destabilize the Dirac spin liquid in the Yb delafossites
summary: The Yb delafossites NaYbSe$_2$, KYbSe$_2$, CsYbSe$_2$ and NaYbO$_2$ are candidates for the U(1) Dirac spin liquid (DSL) of the triangular lattice. Strong spin-orbit coupling gives their exchange an XXZ anisotropy $\Delta$ and bond-dependent couplings $J_{\pm\pm}$, $J_{z\pm}$ that lock the spin frame to the lattice. We show that, within a single layer of a stable Heisenberg DSL, these couplings generate no relevant Lorentz-scalar operator of their own. Inversion at the bond centers removes the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya channel that gaps the kagome DSL, so the locked symmetry forbids a mass, density or current at any order and, assuming continuity, any new monopole term through charge three. Every Lorentz-scalar four-fermion operator induced by spin-orbit coupling shares an SU(4) multiplet, and hence its scaling dimension, with a Heisenberg-allowed one, and the nine non-scalar quartics without such a partner arise only at second order and are irrelevant at large $N$. The Heisenberg DSL itself allows a Lorentz-vector quartic of large-$N$ dimension 2.92, which a stable phase must also render irrelevant. Beyond a single layer, spin-orbit coupling opens an interlayer monopole channel in rhombohedral stacking. If the Heisenberg DSL is instead multicritical, an anisotropy as small as that of KYbSe$_2$ matters only below tens of mK. At the transition to 120$^\circ$ order the anisotropy is relevant, and exact diagonalization indicates that easy-plane anisotropy selects the chiral-Ising class. Existing KYbSe$_2$ neutron data below $J$ do not yet fix the K-point exponent, and gapless out-of-plane spin fluctuations at the K point would test the chiral-Ising selection.

AI.tldr: 在单层 Yb 三角晶格中，自旋轨道耦合诱导的 XXZ 与键依赖耦合不会产生相关 Lorentz 标量算符，因此稳定的 Heisenberg U(1) Dirac 自旋液体对这些微扰具有鲁棒性；层间堆叠和向 120° 序的转变则会引入新的单极子通道或使各向异性变得相关。
AI.motivation: NaYbSe2、KYbSe2、CsYbSe2、NaYbO2 是三角晶格 U(1) Dirac 自旋液体的候选材料，但强自旋轨道耦合会产生 XXZ 各向异性及 J±±、Jz± 等锁定自旋框架的键依赖耦合，需要判断这些微扰是否会破坏 Dirac 自旋液体。
AI.method: 在单层稳定 Heisenberg Dirac 自旋液体框架内做对称性与算符分类，分析自旋轨道耦合诱导的 Lorentz 标量/非标量四费米子算符及其大 N 标度维数；利用 SU(4) 多重态关系、反演对称性、单极子连续性论证，并结合精确对角化与中子数据讨论 120° 序转变和各向异性效应。
AI.result: 单层中这些耦合不产生自身的相关 Lorentz 标量算符；键中心反演消去使 kagome Dirac 自旋液体能隙化的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 通道，锁定对称性禁止任意阶的质量、密度或电流，并在连续性假设下禁止到电荷三的新单极子项。自旋轨道耦合诱导的每个 Lorentz 标量四费米子算符都与某个 Heisenberg 允许算符共享 SU(4) 多重态及标度维数；九个无此类伙伴的非标量四费米子仅在二阶出现且大 N 下无关。Heisenberg Dirac 自旋液体本身允许一个大 N 维数为 2.92 的 Lorentz 矢量四费米子算符，稳定相必须使其无关。多层菱方堆叠中自旋轨道耦合打开层间单极子通道；若 Heisenberg Dirac 自旋液体是多临界的，KYbSe2 量级的各向异性仅在数十 mK 以下重要；在向 120° 序转变时各向异性相关，精确对角化表明易面各向异性选择手性 Ising 类。现有 KYbSe2 的中子数据尚不能确定 K 点指数，K 点无能隙的面外自旋涨落可检验手性 Ising 选择。
AI.conclusion: 单层稳定 Heisenberg Dirac 自旋液体对自旋轨道耦合诱导的对称性允许微扰具有非平凡稳定性；多层堆叠会通过层间单极子通道破坏单纯单层图像，而向 120° 序转变时各向异性变得相关并可能选择手性 Ising 临界类，K 点面外自旋涨落是区分该选择的关键实验信号。

title: Spin-orbit-locked symmetry and the stability of the triangular Dirac spin liquid in the ytterbium delafossites
summary: The Yb delafossites NaYbSe$_2$, KYbSe$_2$, CsYbSe$_2$ and NaYbO$_2$ are candidates for the triangular U(1) Dirac spin liquid, QED$_3$ with $N_f=4$, but their exchange is spin-orbit coupled. Under their spin-orbit-locked space group we determine which operators the XXZ anisotropy and the bond-dependent couplings $J_{\pm\pm}$, $J_{z\pm}$ induce, and at what order. Symmetry forbids every Dirac mass, density and current at any order and, assuming adiabatic continuity, any new monopole term through charge three. At linear order the couplings reach only spin-2 members of the quartic multiplets $\mathbf{20}'$ and $\mathbf{84}$, which share their dimensions with Heisenberg-allowed operators. At second order $J_{\pm\pm}$ and $J_{z\pm}$ renormalize the anisotropy through $J_{z\pm}^2-2J_{\pm\pm}^2$, and nine spin-1 quartics without Heisenberg partners appear, irrelevant at $O(1/N)$. A single layer of a stable Heisenberg spin liquid thus acquires no relevant Lorentz-scalar operator from spin-orbit coupling. The Heisenberg liquid itself allows a Lorentz-vector $\mathbf{20}'$ quartic of large-$N$ dimension 2.92, with two-loop $\epsilon$-expansion estimates 2.9-3.5. Rhombohedral stacking adds triplet-monopole tunneling between layers at first order. At the transition to 120$^\circ$ order the anisotropy is relevant, with crossover exponent $y_T\simeq0.74$-1, and exact diagonalization shows that easy-plane anisotropy selects the chiral-Ising class. The out-of-plane spectrum at the K point then stays gapless, and the spin-flip to non-spin-flip ratio grows as $\omega^{-0.56}$ at leading order. Existing KYbSe$_2$ neutron data below $J$ do not fix the K-point exponent. In-plane fields induce a chiral mass and an out-of-plane moment proportional to $\sin3\varphi$, zero along the bonds and canceling between CsYbSe$_2$ layers, which the planar thermal Hall effect can test.

AI.tldr: 在自旋轨道锁定的空间群下，Yb三角晶格delafossite中的XXZ各向异性与键依赖交换不会给单层U(1) Dirac自旋液体引入相关Lorentz标量算符；主要物理效应是各向异性重整、层间单极隧穿、向120°序转变时的手性Ising临界性，以及可检验的K点谱和面内场诱导响应。
AI.motivation: NaYbSe2、KYbSe2、CsYbSe2和NaYbO2是三角晶格U(1) Dirac自旋液体即Nf=4的QED3候选，但其交换具有自旋轨道耦合；需要判定XXZ各向异性及J±±、Jz±等键依赖耦合会诱导哪些算符、出现在什么阶，并评估自旋轨道耦合是否会破坏该自旋液体。
AI.method: 在自旋轨道锁定的空间群下做对称性分类，确定XXZ与J±±、Jz±诱导的算符及阶数；结合large-N维度、两圈ε展开估计、精确对角化判断临界类；分析菱方堆垛的层间单极隧穿、面内场响应，并与KYbSe2中子数据比较。
AI.result: 对称性在任何阶禁止Dirac质量、密度和流，并在假定绝热连续时通过charge three禁止新的单极项。线性阶耦合只到达四重态多重态20′和84的自旋2成员；二阶J±±与Jz±通过Jz±^2-2J±±^2重整各向异性，并出现九个无Heisenberg伙伴的自旋1四重态算符，在O(1/N)下无关。单层稳定Heisenberg自旋液体不获得相关Lorentz标量算符。Heisenberg液体本身允许large-N维度2.92的Lorentz矢量20′四重态，两圈ε展开估计为2.9-3.5。菱方堆垛在一阶增加层间三重态-单极隧穿。向120°序转变时各向异性相关， crossover指数y_T≃0.74-1；精确对角化表明易面各向异性选择手性Ising类。K点面外谱保持无能隙，自旋翻转与非自旋翻转比按ω^-0.56增长；现有KYbSe2低于J的中子数据不能确定K点指数。面内场诱导手性质量和正比于sin3φ的面外磁矩，沿键为零且在CsYbSe2层间抵消，可由平面热霍尔效应检验。
AI.conclusion: 自旋轨道耦合交换对单层三角晶格U(1) Dirac自旋液体不产生相关Lorentz标量扰动，支持其稳定性；关键可观测包括层间单极隧穿、120°序附近的手性Ising临界性、K点无能隙谱与幂律、以及面内场诱导的sin3φ磁矩和平面热霍尔信号。

title: Ta-based S-I-S junctions for integrated superconducting Electronics
summary: In this work, we have presented S-I-S Josephson junctions with $\rm\alpha$-Ta electrodes and a ${\rm TaO}_x$ barrier. We grew base and top ${\alpha}$-Ta electrodes using seed layer engineering, showing both Nb and ${\rm TaN}_x$ are viable seed layer choices, and particularly emphasize that at room temperature a re-seed layer is required to nucleate $\rm\alpha$-Ta for the top electrode. However, we note that the choice of seed layer can have subtle implications on the electrical tunneling behavior of the junctions. We used room-temperature probing of variable junction areas, combined with Ambegaokar-Baratoff physics, to characterize the wafer scale critical current densities. For 0.4 $\mu$m$^2$ junctions, we found junction spreads as low as 2.0% across the 20 x 20 mm chip relevant for device performance. The entire process was carried out using standard industry foundry processing using 150 mm wafer tooling, which is an important step towards proving that Ta-based junctions can be implemented at scale. We have successfully fabricated and tested junctions with $\rm\alpha$-Ta electrodes and a ${\rm TaO}_x$ insulating tunnel barrier, demonstrating that this is a material platform which merits further investigation and studies for potential application in classical and quantum superconducting technologies.

AI.tldr: 该工作制备并表征了以α-Ta为电极、TaOx为势垒的S-I-S约瑟夫森结，证明其可用于晶圆级、工业兼容的超导器件平台。
AI.motivation: 探索可规模化制造的Ta基约瑟夫森结材料平台，以用于经典与量子超导技术。
AI.method: 采用种子层工程生长底/顶α-Ta电极（Nb和TaNx均可作种子层，顶电极需室温再种子层），制备TaOx隧道势垒；通过室温变面积探测结合Ambegaokar-Baratoff理论提取晶圆级临界电流密度，并使用150 mm晶圆产线工艺。
AI.result: 0.4 μm²结在20×20 mm芯片上的结性能离散低至2.0%；证明种子层选择会影响电学隧穿行为，并实现晶圆级临界电流密度表征。
AI.conclusion: 成功制备并测试α-Ta/TaOx S-I-S约瑟夫森结，显示该材料平台具备进一步研究价值，并有潜力应用于经典和量子超导技术。

title: Current control of spin-wave transport in YIG via the $\small\mathbf{VO}_{\mathbf{2}}$ insulator-to-metal transition
summary: Electrically reconfigurable spin-wave transport is central to realizing energy-efficient magnonic information technologies, yet existing current-driven approaches require current densities that undermine the fundamental dissipation advantage of spin-wave-based signal processing. Here, we demonstrate low-power electrical control of spin-wave propagation in a hybrid magnonic device comprising a low-damping yttrium iron garnet (YIG) film coupled to an adjacent vanadium dioxide ($\small\text{VO}_{2}$) stripe. Passing a small current through $\small\text{VO}_{2}$ triggers its insulator-to-metal transition (IMT), producing a sharp, reversible resistivity reduction exceeding three orders of magnitude. This abrupt phase transition locally modifies the spin-wave dispersion in YIG, reducing the group velocity and suppressing transmission by up to 40 dB near the ferromagnetic resonance frequency. Pulsed current excitation enables reconfiguration of spin-wave transport on a 10 ms timescale. Temperature-dependent measurements, corroborated by thermal modeling, decouple the respective contributions of current-induced heating of YIG and the IMT in $\small\text{VO}_{2}$, establishing the latter as the dominant control mechanism. Our results demonstrate that electrically induced phase transitions in correlated oxides constitute an energy-efficient strategy for dynamic spin-wave manipulation, providing a scalable route toward reconfigurable magnonic devices.

AI.tldr: 利用VO2电流触发绝缘体-金属相变，低功耗调控YIG中自旋波传输，近铁磁共振频率抑制达40 dB，并可在10 ms量级重构。
AI.motivation: 现有电流驱动自旋波调控所需电流密度过高，削弱了自旋波信号处理的本征低耗散优势，因此需要低功耗的电控方案。
AI.method: 构建YIG薄膜与VO2条带耦合的混合磁子器件；小电流通过VO2触发绝缘体-金属转变（IMT），电阻骤降超过三个数量级，局域改变YIG自旋波色散；采用脉冲电流激励，并结合变温测量与热建模区分YIG焦耳加热和VO2 IMT的贡献。
AI.result: VO2的IMT降低自旋波群速度，并在铁磁共振附近将传输抑制最高达40 dB；脉冲电流可在10 ms时间尺度重构自旋波传输；测量与热建模表明VO2的IMT是主导调控机制。
AI.conclusion: 电致相变氧化物可作为一种高能效的动态自旋波调控策略，为可重构磁子器件提供可扩展路径。

title: Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics Reveals Grotthuss Transport in Concentrated Electrolytes
summary: Proton transfer is responsible for the anomalous high conductivity in acidic or basic aqueous solutions. Yet, the contribution of the proton transfer mechanism to the conductivity of concentrated aqueous solutions is unknown. In this work, we compute the transport properties of KOH(aq) systems with different concentrations, using Molecular Dynamics simulations with a Machine Learning Interatomic Potential (MLIP), which includes proton transfer. We quantify the contribution of the proton transfer mechanism to the diffusivities of hydroxide ions and water molecules, and the ionic conductivity and transport numbers of the electrolytes. The contribution is substantial at lower concentrations, but diminishes at very high concentrations.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用包含质子转移的机器学习势分子动力学模拟，定量评估KOH水溶液中质子转移机制对离子/水扩散、离子电导率和迁移数的贡献，发现低浓度下贡献显著、高浓度下减弱。
AI.motivation: 质子转移是酸性或碱性水溶液异常高电导的重要原因，但其在浓水溶液中对电导的贡献尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的分子动力学模拟，计算不同浓度KOH(aq)的输运性质，并量化质子转移机制对氢氧根离子与水的扩散系数、离子电导率及迁移数的贡献。
AI.result: 质子转移对氢氧根离子和水分子扩散、离子电导率及迁移数的贡献在较低浓度下很大，但在极高浓度下明显降低。
AI.conclusion: 质子转移机制对KOH水溶液输运性质的贡献随浓度变化：低浓度时不可忽略，高浓度时减弱。

title: Correlated quantum criticality and topological magnetoelectric response in Bi2Se3
summary: A defining feature of quantum materials is that multiple orders govern low-energy physics and are not independent. We study Bi$_2$Se$_3$ by combining DFT with a renormalized correlated honeycomb model in which frustrated magnetic order and helical topological surface states are coupled via one control parameter. The surface states map to a honeycomb Hubbard model with frustrated $J_1$--$J_2$ exchange. Exact diagonalization up to 20 sites shows the N\'{e}el structure factor and valence-bond-solid order parameter cross at $J_2/J_1 \approx 0.22$, agreeing with QMC/DMRG, and a dynamical spin structure factor broadens near the crossover, as expected for a spinon continuum. Band inversion of the renormalized tight-binding model occurs on the same critical locus, producing jumps in the Chern number and $\mathbb{Z}_2$ invariant mirrored by the skyrmion charge $Q$. This gives a microscopic link: $Q$ selects the axion angle and thus the topological magnetoelectric coupling. We distinguish axion coupling, independent of skyrmion helicity, from the helicity-dependent magnetoelectric multipole coupling, whose toroidal component scales as $\sin\gamma$ and vanishes for N\'{e}el-type textures. We derive the $Q$-topological magnetoelectric energy and estimate $\sim 10^{-20}\,\mathrm{J}$ per skyrmion per cycle for few-tesla fields. The cycle is thermodynamically bounded: constant-$\theta$ cycles extract no net work, and efficiency is limited by axionic entropy change.

AI.tldr: 该文通过DFT结合重正化关联蜂窝模型，将Bi2Se3中的阻挫磁序与螺旋拓扑表面态用单一控制参数耦合，揭示磁序交叉、能带反转与天穹子电荷Q及拓扑磁电耦合之间的微观联系。
AI.motivation: 量子材料中多种序共同支配低能物理且彼此不独立；作者旨在阐明Bi2Se3中阻挫磁性、拓扑表面态和拓扑磁电响应如何由同一参数统一控制。
AI.method: 结合密度泛函理论与重正化关联蜂窝模型：将表面态映射为具有J1-J2阻挫交换的蜂窝Hubbard模型，用最多20格点的精确对角化研究磁序；并对重正化紧束缚模型分析能带反转、Chern数与Z2不变量，将其与天穹子电荷Q及轴子角联系起来。
AI.result: 精确对角化显示Néel结构因子与价键固体序参量在J2/J1≈0.22处交叉，与QMC/DMRG一致；交叉附近动力学自旋结构因子展宽，符合自旋子连续谱。重正化紧束缚模型的能带反转发生在同一临界轨迹上，导致Chern数和Z2不变量跳变，并由天穹子电荷Q镜像反映。作者区分了与天穹子螺旋度无关的轴子耦合和依赖螺旋度的磁电多极耦合，后者环向分量按sinγ缩放并在Néel型织构中消失；推导出Q-拓扑磁电能量在几特斯拉场下约为每个天穹子每周期10^-20 J，并指出恒θ循环不提取净功、效率受轴子熵变限制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了磁织构拓扑荷Q、轴子角与拓扑磁电耦合之间的微观链条，并明确了轴子耦合与螺旋度依赖磁电多极耦合的区别及热力学约束，为Bi2Se3中关联磁序与拓扑响应耦合提供了统一描述。

title: Thermal Phase Transition of Three Dimensional Orthogonal Metals
summary: Orthogonal metals provide a paradigmatic example of strongly entangled metallic states whose transport and thermodynamic properties resemble those of conventional Fermi liquids, while their single-electron excitations remain fundamentally distinct. Despite considerable interest in their unusual ground-state properties, orthogonal metals in three spatial dimensions and their finite-temperature behavior remain relatively unexplored. Here, we investigate a three-dimensional orthogonal metal and characterize the thermodynamic and spectroscopic signatures associated with its finite-temperature phase transition. Starting from a simple model of fermions coupled to spin degrees of freedom, we perturbatively demonstrate that the thermal transition known to occur in the purely bosonic limit persists in the presence of coupling to a gapless Fermi surface. We then examine physical observables that change prominently between the coherent and orthogonal-metal regimes. In particular, we calculate the evolution of the physical-electron spectral function and identify characteristic signatures in angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. We find a pronounced contrast in low-energy spectral weight between the coherent and orthogonal-metal regimes without requiring conventional symmetry-breaking order. Our results establish finite-temperature orthogonal-metal physics as a possible mechanism for pseudogap-like behavior in three-dimensional and quasi-two-dimensional layered materials with non-negligible interlayer hopping, which may be applied to the recent experiments in $\mathrm{Sr_2 VO_3 Fe As}$.

AI.tldr: 研究了三维正交金属的有限温度相变及其热力学与谱学特征，提出无需传统对称破缺即可产生赝能隙样行为的机制。
AI.motivation: 正交金属具有类似费米液体的输运/热力学性质但单电子激发本质不同，然而三维体系及其有限温度行为仍缺乏研究。
AI.method: 从费米子与自旋自由度耦合的简单模型出发，微扰证明纯玻色极限中的热相变在耦合无能隙费米面后仍存在；计算物理电子谱函数并识别ARPES特征。
AI.result: 发现相干金属区与正交金属区的低能谱权重存在显著对比，且不依赖常规对称破缺序；该对比可表现为赝能隙样行为。
AI.conclusion: 确立有限温度正交金属物理作为三维及准二维层状材料中赝能隙样行为的可能机制，适用于具有不可忽略层间跃迁的体系，并可应用于Sr2VO3FeAs相关实验。

title: Collective Modes of Fractional States Beyond Landau Levels
summary: Collective modes provide a powerful probe into the properties and stability of topologically ordered and strongly interacting phases of matter, such as fractional quantum Hall states. Yet, the description of fractional-state excitations away from the Landau-level limit remains a formidable challenge. We develop a framework for describing collective excitations in the strong-coupling regime of coupled-wire constructions and show that they emerge as solitons and breathers of effective sine-Gordon theories. This approach provides a systematic route to studying collective modes in a broad class of fractional states. Applied to a coupled-wire construction of the fractional quantum Hall effect, the framework captures key features of the magnetoroton branch. It naturally extends to fractional Chern insulators, demonstrating that magnetoroton-like collective modes persist well beyond the Landau-level limit. We find that the magnetoroton gap increases as the Fubini-Study metric approaches the ideal (trace-condition) limit, highlighting the important role of quantum geometry in the stability of fractionalized phases and their collective excitations. The same trend favors the stability of the long-wavelength quadrupolar mode associated with the chiral graviton. Together, these results identify a distinct interplay between fractionalization and quantum geometry, and provide an analytical framework for studies of collective excitations in fractional topological matter.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于耦合线构造和有效 sine-Gordon 理论的框架，用孤子与呼吸子描述强耦合区分数拓扑态中的集体激发，并揭示量子几何对磁振子及手性引力子模稳定性的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 分数量子霍尔等分数态在偏离朗道能级极限时，其集体激发的描述仍是重大挑战；需要系统框架研究强相互作用与拓扑有序相中的集体模式。
AI.method: 在耦合线构造的强耦合区发展描述集体激发的框架，将其映射为有效 sine-Gordon 理论中的孤子和呼吸子；应用于分数量子霍尔效应及分数陈绝缘体的耦合线模型。
AI.result: 该框架捕捉到磁振子支的关键特征，并表明磁振子类集体模式可远超朗道能级极限而存在；当 Fubini-Study 度规趋近理想迹条件极限时，磁振子能隙增大，且同一趋势有利于与手性引力子相关的长波四极模式的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了分数化与量子几何之间的独特相互作用，并为研究分数拓扑物质中的集体激发提供了可推广的解析框架。

title: Repulsion-Driven Topological Superconductivity in Twisted MoTe$_2$
summary: We show that a microscopic model of twisted MoTe$_2$ with screened Coulomb interactions produces topological superconductivity. Using the density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) on infinite cylinders, we find that the narrow Chern band of twisted MoTe$_2$ has Cooper pair correlations that strengthen with cylinder circumference, consistent with two dimensional superconductivity. The superconductor has chiral $f$-wave pairing around the valley center, and its topology produces chiral Majorana edge modes and non-Abelian vortex cores. At zero displacement field, the superconductor spans fillings $-0.78\lesssim\nu\lesssim-0.72$, close to the experimental range, and extends in a dome to finite displacement field. We then predict how its stiffness evolves with the filling and the tunable displacement field. The interplay with screening length is also examined. Nearby, we find a fractional Chern insulator, a topological charge density wave, a metal, and a charge-ordered state. The last is a candidate for the reentrant integer Hall regime in experiments. These results establish a route from repulsive interactions in microscopic models of moir\'e materials to chiral topological uperconductors with chiral Majorana edge modes.

AI.tldr: 在 twisted MoTe$_2$ 的微观模型中，屏蔽库仑相互作用可产生手性 $f$ 波拓扑超导，并伴随手性 Majorana 边缘态和非阿贝尔涡旋核。
AI.motivation: 研究莫尔材料中由排斥相互作用驱动的超导机制，尤其是窄 Chern 带中能否从微观模型自然得到拓扑超导，并解释 twisted MoTe$_2$ 实验中的超导与相邻拓扑相。
AI.method: 采用无限柱面上的密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）研究带屏蔽库仑相互作用的 twisted MoTe$_2$ 微观模型，系统改变柱面周长、填充因子、位移场和屏蔽长度。
AI.result: 发现 Cooper 对关联随柱面周长增强，符合二维超导；配对为谷中心附近的手性 $f$ 波，拓扑性质给出手性 Majorana 边缘模和非阿贝尔涡旋核。零位移场下超导出现在 $-0.78\lesssim\nu\lesssim-0.72$，接近实验区间，并在有限位移场下形成超导穹顶；预测超流刚度随填充和位移场的演化，并考察屏蔽长度影响。邻近相包括分数量子 Chern 绝缘体、拓扑电荷密度波、金属和电荷有序态，后者是重入整数量子霍尔区的候选。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了从莫尔材料微观模型中的排斥相互作用到具有手性 Majorana 边缘模的手性拓扑超导体的路线。

title: Korringa factor in Dirac-nodal-line systems
summary: The Korringa factor $K(\alpha)$ in the nuclear magnetic resonance studies is a widely used measure of electron-correlation effects in metals and is conventionally interpreted using the non-correlated value $K(\alpha)$ = 1. In Dirac-fermion systems, however, the non-correlated reference value depends on the electronic density of states (DOS) and differs from that of conventional metals. Here, we theoretically investigate the non-correlated Korringa factor $K^*(\alpha)$ in a Dirac nodal-line (DNL) system with finite nodal-line dispersion using a DOS-based approach. We show that $K^*(\alpha)$ exhibits an intrinsic temperature dependence, continuously evolving from the Dirac-fermion value of 1.71 at high temperatures to the metallic value of 1 at low temperatures. The crossover temperature is found to be proportional to the nodal-line dispersion width, identified as the characteristic energy scale governing the non-correlated Korringa factor in DNL systems. We further demonstrate that Landau quantization generates singular DOS structures that strongly enhance $K^*(\alpha)$, producing pronounced peaks even in the absence of electron correlations. In addition, $K^*(\alpha)$ exhibits two distinct types of magnetic oscillations arising from intra-level and inter-level contributions. The latter originates from the overlap of singular points belonging to positive and negative quantum-number Landau subbands at the Fermi level and represents a unique consequence of the finite energy dispersion of a DNL. These results provide a quantitative reference for interpreting NMR experiments in DNL materials and for identifying genuine correlation effects beyond DOS-induced contributions.

AI.tldr: 本文从态密度（DOS）角度理论研究有限节点线色散的狄拉克节点线（DNL）体系中的非关联Korringa因子 K*(α)，揭示其内禀温度依赖、朗道量子化增强及两类磁振荡。
AI.motivation: Korringa因子常用于衡量金属中的电子关联效应，但通常以非关联值 K=1 为参考；在狄拉克费米子体系中，非关联参考值依赖DOS且不同于常规金属，因此需要建立DNL体系的定量参考。
AI.method: 采用基于DOS的方法，计算有限节点线色散的DNL体系中非关联Korringa因子 K*(α)，并分析温度、节点线色散宽度及朗道量子化对DOS和 K*(α) 的影响。
AI.result: K*(α) 表现出内禀温度依赖：高温趋于狄拉克费米子值1.71，低温趋于金属值1；交叉温度正比于节点线色散宽度。朗道量子化产生奇异DOS结构并显著增强 K*(α)，即使无电子关联也可出现明显峰。K*(α) 还呈现由能级内和能级间贡献产生的两类磁振荡，后者源于正、负量子数朗道子带奇异点在费米能级重叠，是DNL有限能量色散的特有结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为DNL材料NMR实验提供定量解释参考，并有助于区分真实的电子关联效应与DOS诱导贡献。

title: Resolving magnetic order and dynamics with polarized neutron scattering: a practical guide to longitudinal polarization analysis
summary: Neutron scattering provides microscopic information on magnetic order and spin dynamics. Most experiments, however, use unpolarized neutrons and do not fully exploit the information carried by the neutron spin. Longitudinal polarization analysis (LPA), established in the pioneering work of Moon, Riste, and Koehler at Oak Ridge National Laboratory in the late 1960s, separates magnetic and nonmagnetic scattering contributions through their different effects on the neutron spin. In this review, we illustrate how LPA can distinguish weak magnetic scattering from nonmagnetic contributions, constrain small moment components, and resolve the spin-space anisotropy of magnetic excitations. We introduce the formalism connecting measured polarization channels to magnetic quantities and discuss scattering geometry, crystallographic projections, and corrections for finite polarization. Our aim is to provide a practical guide for neutron scatterers using LPA to determine magnetic structures and characterize spin excitations in quantum materials. We conclude with opportunities in altermagnets, unconventional superconductors, and kagome magnets.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统介绍纵向极化分析（LPA）在中子散射中分离磁性与非磁性散射、确定磁结构和表征自旋激发中的应用，并提供实用方法指南。
AI.motivation: 多数中子散射实验使用非极化中子，未充分利用中子自旋所携带的信息；LPA可通过中子自旋在不同散射过程中的变化区分磁性与非磁性贡献。
AI.method: 回顾Moon、Riste和Koehler建立的LPA方法，介绍将实测极化通道与磁学量联系起来的 formalism，并讨论散射几何、晶体学投影以及有限极化修正。
AI.result: LPA能够从非磁性背景中识别弱磁散射、约束小磁矩分量，并解析磁激发的自旋空间各向异性。
AI.conclusion: 该文为利用LPA研究中子散射的科研人员提供确定磁结构和表征量子材料自旋激发的实践指南，并指出在交变磁体、非常规超导体和笼目磁体中的未来机会。

title: LaQX: A JAX Toolkit for Neural Quantum State Simulations of Lattice Quantum Many-Body Models
summary: Neural quantum states provide accurate variational representations for interacting lattice fermions and spins. Turning a new ansatz into a reproducible calculation, however, requires coordinated implementations of the Hamiltonian, sampling, optimization, observables, and accelerator parallelism. We present LaQX (Lattice Quantum simulation based on jaX), an open-source neural quantum state library based on JAX that organizes these components through common functional interfaces. Beyond ground-state variational Monte Carlo, LaQX supports excited-state calculations, Green's Function Monte Carlo refinement, adiabatic evolution, and real-time evolution with time-dependent variational Monte Carlo. It consolidates methods developed in recent high-accuracy neural quantum state studies of the Hubbard model and frustrated magnets, and the package has been used to investigate the triangular-lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard model. We document these capabilities with reproducible calculations for Hubbard, $J_1$-$J_2$ Heisenberg, altermagnetic Hubbard, and interacting Hofstadter models. Function-oriented modules separate the scientific components and limit the source context needed for extensions by human developers and large language models. Source code, documentation, and executable examples are available at https://github.com/bytedance/laqx.

AI.tldr: LaQX 是一个基于 JAX 的开源神经量子态库，通过统一函数式接口整合格点费米子/自旋体系的哈密顿量、采样、优化、可观测量与加速器并行，并支持多种基态与激发态量子模拟方法。
AI.motivation: 神经量子态虽能高精度变分描述相互作用格点体系，但新 ansatz 要成为可复现计算，需协同实现哈密顿量、采样、优化、可观测量和并行计算；同时需降低扩展所需的源码上下文，便于人类开发者和大型语言模型参与扩展。
AI.method: 作者提出 LaQX（Lattice Quantum simulation based on jaX），以 JAX 为基础，用面向函数的模块分离科学组件并提供公共函数式接口；除基态变分蒙特卡洛外，还支持激发态计算、Green's Function Monte Carlo 精化、绝热演化和基于时间依赖变分蒙特卡洛的实时演化，并整合近期 Hubbard 模型与阻挫磁体高精度神经量子态研究中的方法。
AI.result: 该库已被用于研究三角晶格 Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型，并通过 Hubbard、J1-J2 Heisenberg、交变磁性 Hubbard 和相互作用 Hofstadter 模型的可复现计算展示其能力；源码、文档和可执行示例见 https://github.com/bytedance/laqx。
AI.conclusion: LaQX 提供了可复现、模块化、可扩展的神经量子态计算框架，覆盖基态、激发态、精化与实时/绝热演化等多类格点量子模拟任务，并便于后续扩展与复用。

title: Thermodynamic Evidence for Multiple Field-Induced Phases in an Anisotropic Kagome Antiferromagnet
summary: Kagome antiferromagnets are predicted to host exotic field-induced phases, yet experimental identification of their thermodynamic signatures remains challenging. Here we combine specific heat ($C$) and ultrasound measurements up to 36 T and down to 0.5 K to map the $H-T$ phase diagram of the anisotropic kagome magnet Y$_3$Cu$_9$(OH)$_{19}$Cl$_8$. We show that the suppression of long-range antiferromagnetic order with field at $\sim 15$ T approximately coincides with the onset of the unconventional $1/6$ (or $1/9$) magnetization plateau previously observed in this system. The attenuation (and sound velocity) then intriguingly increases down to 0.5 K just at $\mu_0H = 15$ T, and $C/T$ becomes temperature independent. Moreover, our measurements are consistent with the opening of a spin gap $\Delta_0\simeq3.5\pm 0.3$ K within the plateau and reveal a further compressible (ungapped) phase beyond the plateau phase, unveiling a rich sequence of field-induced phases in this quantum magnet.

AI.tldr: 结合比热与超声测量，绘制了各向异性Kagome反铁磁体Y3Cu9(OH)19Cl8的H-T相图，揭示约15 T处反铁磁序抑制与1/6（或1/9）磁化平台起始重合，并发现平台内自旋能隙及平台外无隙可压缩相。
AI.motivation: Kagome反铁磁体被预测具有奇异场诱导相，但其热力学特征难以实验识别。
AI.method: 在高达36 T磁场和低至0.5 K温度下，联合比热C与超声测量，构建Y3Cu9(OH)19Cl8的H-T相图。
AI.result: 约15 T处长程反铁磁序被抑制，并与非常规1/6（或1/9）磁化平台起始近似重合；在μ0H=15 T处，衰减（及声速）随降温至0.5 K而增加，C/T变为与温度无关；测量与平台内约Δ0≈3.5±0.3 K的自旋能隙一致，并揭示平台之外还存在进一步的可压缩（无能隙）相。
AI.conclusion: 该量子磁体表现出丰富的场诱导相序列，并为Kagome反铁磁体的奇异场诱导相提供热力学与声学证据。

title: Small-data physics-informed ML model for magnetic exchange based on chemical composition and structure
summary: In this paper we propose an ensemble model based on a swarm of dense neural networks, able to predict Heisenberg exchange interactions within less than 1% error. The model uses the inputs of the ab-initio Schr\"odinger equation, i.e. the compound structure and chemical composition. In this first work, we trained the model on a few compounds of the hexagonal manganite family and were able to infer, with similar accuracy, the J values for other compounds of the same family at randomly chosen geometries, thus showing that we accurately learned the effect of the chemical composition and structure on effective magnetic integrals J.

AI.tldr: 提出一种由密集神经网络群组成的集成模型，仅以化合物结构和化学组分为输入，即可高精度预测海森堡交换相互作用 J，误差低于 1%。
AI.motivation: 从头算求解海森堡交换积分 J 成本高；希望利用机器学习从 Schrödinger 方程相关输入（结构与化学组成）直接学习并快速预测 J。
AI.method: 构建基于稠密神经网络群的集成模型，输入为化合物结构与化学组成；先在少数六方锰氧化物家族化合物上训练。
AI.result: 模型预测 J 的误差小于 1%；并能以相近精度推断同一家族其他化合物在随机选择几何下的 J 值。
AI.conclusion: 模型有效学习了化学组成和结构对有效磁积分 J 的影响，展示了在同类材料中高精度、可迁移预测交换相互作用的潜力。

title: Closed- and open-system characterization of the Yukawa-SYK model in real time
summary: Strongly correlated matter without quasiparticles is central to many-body physics, quantum chaos, and quantum gravity, motivating a considerable effort toward its realization in tabletop experiments. Two challenges remain: laboratory platforms are open systems, so conformal behavior must survive dissipation, and it must be identified through measurable quantities. We address both challenges in the Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (YSYK) model, in which bosons and fermions interact as in, e.g., light-matter systems, but through random all-to-all couplings that drive the boson to criticality without fine tuning. Solving the model in real time using the Schwinger-Keldysh formalism, we treat closed and open systems within a unified framework and, in both cases, consider a thermal steady state to map their phase diagrams. In addition to the known conformal and impurity (or SYK$_2$) regimes, we identify novel high-temperature regimes in which the fermions are driven by an essentially bare boson and show that their dynamics is captured by a quadratic model with time-dependent random hopping. Across all regimes, the fermionic softening of the boson is bounded by a ``criticality budget'' determined only by the Yukawa coupling and the temperature. Coupling the boson with a thermal environment induces a mass shift that deforms the boundaries between different regimes and exhausts the criticality budget, thus imposing a bound on temperature and dissipation rate compatible with self-tuned criticality. We further introduce a set of markers built from the two-point functions that separate all identified regimes, are accessible in linear response, and require no fit of the conformal exponents. We complement them with the quantum Fisher information, deriving upper bounds with and without dissipation. These results may help characterize holographic quantum matter beyond the closed setting.

AI.tldr: 研究Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（YSYK）模型在封闭与开放系统中的实时动力学，识别新高温区、临界预算、耗散约束及可测量的两点函数标记。
AI.motivation: 强关联无准粒子物质对多体物理、量子混沌和量子引力重要，但桌面实验实现面临开放系统耗散下共形行为能否存活以及如何通过可测量量识别两大挑战。
AI.method: 采用Schwinger-Keldysh实时形式统一处理封闭与开放YSYK模型，考虑热稳态并映射相图；引入基于两点函数的标记和量子Fisher信息分析。
AI.result: 除已知共形和杂质（SYK2）区外，发现费米子由裸玻色子驱动的高温区，其动力学由含时随机跃迁二次模型描述；玻色子费米软化受仅由Yukawa耦合和温度决定的临界预算限制；热环境导致质量移动、改变区间边界并耗尽预算，给出温度与耗散率上界；构造可线性响应测量且无需拟合共形指数的标记，并推导有无耗散下量子Fisher信息上界。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为表征开放/耗散条件下超越封闭设定的全息量子物质提供了统一框架和可测判据。

title: Hidden Triakontadipole Order in the Triangular-Lattice Magnet CeMgAl$_{11}$O$_{19}$
summary: The absence of magnetic Bragg peaks and a broad excitation continuum are commonly recognized experimental features of a quantum spin liquid. The Ce-based triangular-lattice hexaaluminate CeMgAl$_{11}$O$_{19}$ exhibits both signatures, yet its effective model and ground state remain under debate. Experiments have variously suggested a quantum spin liquid, proximate umbrella point, and disorder-suppressed magnetic order. Here we trace these contradictions to an overlooked multipolar degree of freedom: the transverse pseudospin of the $|\pm5/2\rangle$ Kramers doublet is a rank-5 triakontadipole rather than an ordinary dipole. Analyzing the magnetization, neutron spectra, and thermodynamics on equal footing, we establish a dipole-triakontadipole XXZ model with $J_{\perp} \simeq 0.65$ K and $J_c \simeq -0.13$ K. The resulting planar triakontadipolar superfluid order is hidden from dipolar probes, explaining the absence of a magnetic Bragg peak in neutron scattering. The zero-field excitations separate into a low-energy triakontadipole wave and a broad higher-energy continuum. We further propose nuclear spin-lattice relaxation and spin-current experiments to probe the gapless excitations of this hidden triakontadipole superfluid. Our findings thus open a new avenue for high-rank multipolar physics in rare-earth triangular-lattice magnets.

AI.tldr: 该文认为CeMgAl11O19中“量子自旋液体、伞状点邻近、无序抑制磁序”等矛盾源于忽略了|±5/2⟩ Kramers双重态的横向赝自旋实为rank-5 triakontadipole，而非普通偶极。
AI.motivation: CeMgAl11O19同时缺乏磁Bragg峰并具有宽激发连续谱，但有效模型和基态仍有争议；作者旨在统一解释磁化、中子谱和热力学信号。
AI.method: 将磁化、中子散射谱和热力学置于同一框架，建立偶极–triakontadipole XXZ模型，得到J⊥≈0.65 K、Jc≈−0.13 K，并分析零场激发与实验可观测性。
AI.result: 模型给出平面triakontadipolar超流序，该序对偶极探针隐藏，从而解释中子散射无磁Bragg峰；零场激发分为低能triakontadipole波和较宽的高能连续谱。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出用核自旋-晶格弛豫和自旋流实验探测该隐藏triakontadipole超流的无能隙激发，为稀土三角晶格磁体中的高秩多极物理开辟新方向。

title: SrMn$_2$Ge$_2$: A metallic system with anomalous magnetotransport properties
summary: The structural, electronic, and physical properties of previously unexplored layered tetragonal compound SrMn$_2$Ge$_2$ are reported. The compound crystallizes in the ThCr$_2$Si$_2$-type structure with a crystallographic parameters $c/a$ ratio of $2.535(3)$, significantly smaller than those of the related BaMn$_2$$Pn_2$ compounds ($Pn =$ P, As, Sb, Bi), indicating enhanced interlayer interaction between the moment-bearing Mn-ions. Magnetic susceptibility measurements suggest an antiferromagnetic ground state with a high Ne\'{e}l temperature $T_{\rm N} > 350$~K\@. A large and positive magnetoresistance (MR) of approximately $50\%$ is observed at low temperatures, which follows a power-law field dependence with exponent $n = 1.50(8)$. Low-temperature electrical resistivity data reveal Kondo-like features. Heat capacity measurements show no signs of a phase transition below 300~K and further confirm a metallic ground state. Electronic structure calculations reveal a three-dimensional Fermi surface and suggest the presence of substantial electronic correlation effects.

AI.tldr: 首次报道层状四方化合物 SrMn2Ge2 的结构、电子与物理性质：其为 ThCr2Si2 型金属，具有高奈尔温度反铁磁基态、低温柔约 50% 正磁阻及 Kondo 样输运特征，并显示较强电子关联。
AI.motivation: SrMn2Ge2 此前未被研究；通过与 BaMn2Pn2（Pn=P, As, Sb, Bi）比较，可揭示层间 Mn 相互作用、磁性、输运和电子关联对结构参数的依赖。
AI.method: 采用结构表征确定晶体结构与 c/a；通过磁化率测量研究磁有序；测量低温磁阻与电阻率；用热容判断相变和基态；结合电子结构计算分析费米面与关联效应。
AI.result: SrMn2Ge2 为 ThCr2Si2 型结构，c/a=2.535(3)，显著小于相关 BaMn2Pn2，表明层间 Mn 相互作用增强；磁化率显示反铁磁基态且 T_N>350 K；低温磁阻约 50% 且为正，遵循指数 n=1.50(8) 的幂律场依赖；电阻率呈 Kondo 样特征；300 K 以下热容无相变迹象并确认金属基态；计算给出三维费米面并提示显著电子关联。
AI.conclusion: SrMn2Ge2 是一种具有高 T_N、增强层间耦合、大正磁阻和 Kondo 样输运的反铁磁金属，并存在明显电子关联，为研究层状 Mn 基化合物的磁性、输运与关联物理提供了新平台。

title: Many Electrons, One Determinant: Hartree--Fock Theory, Basis Sets, and Molecular Integrals
summary:
This chapter accompanies the lectures on Hartree--Fock theory and on basis sets and molecular integrals at the \href{https://www.esqc.org}{European Summer School of Quantum Chemistry (ESQC) 2026}. Intended for doctoral students, it develops the single-determinant description of electronic structure from antisymmetry and the variational principle to the orbital equations and their finite-basis matrix representation. Detailed derivations connect the energy functional, the Fock operator, excited determinants, and the interpretation of orbital energies. Restricted, unrestricted, and generalized formulations show how the choice of variational space affects spin symmetry, symmetry breaking, and the limitations of the Hartree--Fock approximation.
  The computational development covers orthogonalization, self-consistent-field iteration, convergence acceleration, overlap-based occupation selection, and orbital analysis, distinguishing orbital stationarity from stability. A connection to second-order M{\o}ller--Plesset perturbation theory explains the correlation-energy expression and the cost of transforming electron-repulsion integrals from atomic to molecular orbitals.
  The basis-set and integral development examines radial and angular flexibility, contraction, basis-set incompleteness, and superposition error. The Gaussian product theorem leads to one- and two-electron integrals, recurrence relations, integral screening, and low-rank representations. Worked examples and exercises with detailed solutions connect these derivations to practical calculations. Historical perspectives and explicit notation conventions provide context for the approximations and algorithms that underpin molecular electronic-structure theory.

AI.tldr: 该章节是 ESQC 2026 关于 Hartree–Fock 理论及基组与分子积分讲座的配套教材，从反对称性和变分原理出发系统推导单行列式电子结构理论，并覆盖 SCF 实现、MP2 关联能以及高斯积分技术。
AI.motivation: 面向博士生提供一条从形式理论到实用算法的连贯学习路径，弥合 Hartree–Fock、基组和分子积分在理论推导与实际计算之间的差距。
AI.method: 详细推导能量泛函、Fock 算符、激发行列式和轨道能解释；比较限制型、非限制型和广义 Hartree–Fock 表述；讨论正交化、SCF 迭代、收敛加速、占据选择、轨道分析及稳定性；联系二阶 Møller–Plesset 微扰理论说明关联能表达式和电子排斥积分从原子轨道到分子轨道的变换成本；分析基组的径向/角向灵活性、收缩、不完备性和叠加误差；由高斯乘积定理导出单/双电子积分、递推关系、积分筛选和低秩表示，并配有例题、习题与详细解答。
AI.result: 阐明变分空间选择如何影响自旋对称性、对称性破缺和 Hartree–Fock 近似局限；区分轨道驻点性与稳定性；解释关联能及积分变换代价；展示基组与积分近似背后的算法及其实际计算含义。
AI.conclusion: 该章节为分子电子结构理论提供了兼顾历史背景、记号约定、严格推导和计算实践的综合性教学基础，将 Hartree–Fock、基组与分子积分的形式体系连接到可操作算法和实例计算。

title: Intra-unit-cell Josephson scanning tunneling spectroscopy of the cuprate Bi$_{1.2}$Pb$_{0.8}$Sr$_2$CaCu$_2$O$_{8+\delta}$
summary: The predominantly $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave pairing symmetry of cuprate superconductors is well established, yet its microscopic manifestation in local Cooper-pair tunneling remains less explored. Here, we investigate Bi$_{1.2}$Pb$_{0.8}$Sr$_2$CaCu$_2$O$_{8+\delta}$, using Josephson scanning tunneling spectroscopy with a conventional $s$-wave superconducting Pb tip. We observe a zero-bias conductance enhancement whose approximately quadratic dependence on junction conductance is consistent with phase-diffusive Josephson tunneling. Atomic-resolution conductance maps and site-resolved spectra reveal a pronounced intra-unit-cell modulation, with enhanced Josephson response near oxygen sites and strong suppression near copper sites and along diagonal directions. Microscopic calculations incorporating the bilayer electronic structure and realistic Wannier-based tunneling matrix elements reproduce the observed spatial pattern through interference between pairing contributions of opposite signs. Our results reveal how the sign-changing $d$-wave superconducting order parameter manifests itself in atomic-scale Josephson tunneling, providing complementary evidence for unconventional pairing symmetry in cuprates.

AI.tldr: 利用s波Pb针尖对Bi2212进行约瑟夫森扫描隧道谱，观察到零偏压电导增强及原子尺度空间调制，并结合计算揭示符号变化的d波配对在局域库珀对隧穿中的表现。
AI.motivation: 铜氧化物超导体的d_{x^2-y^2}波配对对称性已确立，但其在局域库珀对隧穿中的微观表现仍研究不足。
AI.method: 对Bi_{1.2}Pb_{0.8}Sr_2CaCu_2O_{8+δ}使用常规s波超导Pb针尖开展约瑟夫森扫描隧道谱，获得原子分辨电导图和位点分辨谱，并进行包含双层电子结构和基于Wannier的隧穿矩阵元的微观计算。
AI.result: 观察到零偏压电导增强，其随结电导近似二次依赖，符合相位扩散约瑟夫森隧穿；电导图显示显著的原胞内调制，氧位点附近约瑟夫森响应增强，铜位点和对角线方向强烈抑制；微观计算通过相反符号配对贡献的干涉重现该空间图样。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明符号变化的d波超导序参量如何在原子尺度约瑟夫森隧穿中显现，为铜氧化物非常规配对对称性提供了补充证据。

title: Nonreciprocal charge transport in quantum materials: From superconductors to magnetic systems
summary: Nonreciprocal charge transport, where current flows preferentially in one direction, has become a key topic across quantum materials. This review covers some recent progress in bulk crystals, artificial heterostructures, van der Waals systems, high-temperature superconductors, and magnetic materials. The review discusses both intrinsic origins, such as band-structure effects, and extrinsic ones, including vortex motion, device geometry, and heating artifacts. A central focus is the superconducting diode effect due to its application potential, which shows different critical currents for opposite directions. The review also examines how symmetry breaking, spin-orbit coupling, and magnetic order contribute to the observed responses. However, there remain challenges when many exciting findings lack a unified picture, and the field continues to debate the relative importance of various mechanisms. The review highlights key open questions and suggests future directions, including better experimental standards and device integration. This review aims to give a balanced view of what is known, what is uncertain, and where the field might go next.

AI.tldr: 综述非互易电荷输运与超导二极管效应的近期进展，覆盖多种材料体系、内在/外在机制、争议及未来方向。
AI.motivation: 非互易电荷输运在量子材料中日益重要，但相关发现分散且缺乏统一图景，需平衡梳理已知、不确定与待解决问题。
AI.method: 综述块体晶体、人工异质结、范德华体系、高温超导体和磁性材料中的进展；讨论能带结构等内在机制与涡旋运动、器件几何、加热伪影等外在机制；重点分析超导二极管效应及对称破缺、自旋轨道耦合和磁序的作用。
AI.result: 不同体系中观察到非互易响应和超导二极管效应（正反方向临界电流不同），但机制多样且相对重要性仍有争议，许多结果缺乏统一解释。
AI.conclusion: 该领域需建立统一框架、改进实验标准并推进器件集成，同时明确关键开放问题与未来研究方向。

title: Long-horizon Forecasting of Sodium-ion Battery Charge-profile Evolution and Degradation using Autoregressive Deep Sequence Models
summary: Accurate long-horizon battery ageing prediction remains challenging because degradation alters not only scalar health indicators but also the shape and duration of electrochemical cycling profiles. Here, we introduce an autoregressive deep sequence-learning framework to forecast voltage-current profiles and state-of-health (SOH) evolution in NVPF/hard-carbon sodium-ion batteries. Stacked LSTM (Batt-LSTM) and hybrid CNN-LSTM (Batt-LSTM-C) models learn from voltage, current, and cycle-index sequences to generate future cycling profiles iteratively from measured data. Scheduled sampling mitigates the training-inference mismatch during autoregressive rollout, extending stable forecasting horizons from a few tens of cycles to as many as 600 cycles while preserving local waveform fidelity. Horizon-dependent benchmarking against classical machine-learning models evaluates voltage mean absolute error (MAE), global and local dynamic time warping (DTW), and SOH MAE across five forecasting horizons. Batt-LSTM with scheduled sampling achieves the lowest voltage MAE at horizons from 5,000 to 20,000 time steps. The predicted profiles also enable extraction of capacity-, resistance-, and energy-based SOH indicators, together with internal-resistance evolution. Monte Carlo dropout and deep ensembles estimate predictive spread at local profile and global degradation-trajectory scales. Fine-tuning on an independent ageing dataset improves cross-cell adaptation, with rolling-horizon updates reducing SOH prediction error to 3.844 percentage points for a 200-cycle horizon. These results show that curve-level forecasting retains diagnostically relevant electrochemical information beyond scalar SOH regression and offers a route toward uncertainty-aware, adaptive battery-health monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出自回归深度序列学习框架，预测NVPF/硬碳钠离子电池的电压-电流曲线与SOH演化；调度采样将稳定预测范围从数十循环扩展至600循环，曲线级预测保留诊断相关电化学信息并支持不确定性感知的健康监测。
AI.motivation: 长期电池老化预测困难，因为退化不仅改变标量健康指标，还改变电化学循环曲线的形状和持续时间；仅做标量SOH回归会丢失曲线级诊断信息。
AI.method: 构建堆叠LSTM（Batt-LSTM）与CNN-LSTM（Batt-LSTM-C）模型，基于电压、电流和循环索引序列迭代生成未来循环曲线；采用scheduled sampling缓解自回归训练-推理不匹配。在五个预测horizon上与经典机器学习模型基准比较电压MAE、全局/局部DTW和SOH MAE；从预测曲线提取容量、电阻、能量类SOH指标及内阻演化，并用Monte Carlo dropout和deep ensembles估计局部曲线与全局退化轨迹的不确定性；在独立老化数据上微调并采用滚动horizon更新提升跨电池适配。
AI.result: Batt-LSTM结合scheduled sampling在5,000至20,000时间步horizon上取得最低电压MAE；稳定预测范围扩展至多达600循环且保持局部波形保真。预测曲线可提取多类SOH指标和内阻演化；独立数据微调与滚动更新将200循环horizon的SOH预测误差降至3.844个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 曲线级预测能保留标量SOH回归之外的诊断相关电化学信息，为不确定性感知、自适应的电池健康监测提供可行路径。

title: A Simulation-Driven Digital Workflow Integrating Bayesian Optimization for Early-Stage Process Design: A Methyl Acetate Production Case Study
summary: Methyl acetate production via direct carbonylation of dimethyl ether and carbon monoxide involves strong nonlinear interactions among reactor operation, recycle structure, and energy consumption, making conventional simulation-based optimization computationally demanding. In this work, a data-driven framework integrating steady-state process simulation, surrogate modeling, and Bayesian optimization was developed for process intensification. A dataset of 2730 steady-state simulations was generated using a Python-based automated process simulation workflow and a structured design of experiments across the operating domain. Surrogate models were trained to predict carbon conversion yield (C-yield) and cost of specific energy consumption (C-SEC), with neural network-based models showing the best predictive performance and robustness. These models were integrated into a multi-objective Bayesian optimization framework to identify optimal operating regions. Results indicate that high C-yield (up to ~95%) can be achieved with reduced energy cost through lower recycle flow rates and compression demand. Pareto analysis revealed a nonlinear trade-off between C-yield and C-SEC, where further improvements near the conversion limit require disproportionately higher energy input. Validation against rigorous simulations showed deviations below 3% for C-yield and 10% for C-SEC.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个集成稳态流程模拟、代理模型和多目标贝叶斯优化的数据驱动框架，用于乙酸甲酯直接羰基化过程的强化与操作优化。
AI.motivation: 二甲醚与CO直接羰基化制乙酸甲酯过程中，反应器操作、循环结构和能耗之间存在强非线性耦合，传统基于模拟的优化计算成本高。
AI.method: 通过Python自动化流程模拟和结构化实验设计生成2730组稳态模拟数据；训练代理模型预测碳转化率（C-yield）和单位能耗成本（C-SEC），其中神经网络模型表现最佳；将代理模型嵌入多目标贝叶斯优化框架以识别最优操作区域并进行Pareto分析。
AI.result: 可获得约95%的高C-yield，并通过降低循环流量和压缩需求降低能耗成本；C-yield与C-SEC呈非线性权衡，接近转化率极限时能耗代价显著增加；严格模拟验证显示C-yield偏差低于3%，C-SEC偏差低于10%。
AI.conclusion: 该数据驱动代理建模与贝叶斯优化框架能有效降低计算负担，识别乙酸甲酯羰基化过程的最优操作区域和能效权衡，为过程强化提供可行方法。

title: A local orchestration harness for molecular design with foundation models
summary: Molecular design requires coordinated generation, property prediction and iterative editing, with each decision linked to the correct chemical structure and supporting evidence. Integrating these capabilities in practice presents three major challenges: retaining local control of molecular data, connecting specialized models across tasks and verifying that proposed changes satisfy chemical constraints. Here we present MolCrew, a locally deployable system that coordinates four separately trained molecular specialists with a language-model orchestrator and RDKit calculations. The specialists generate structures from descriptions, describe molecular structures, predict biological endpoints and propose edits towards specified goals. Separate model weights allow each capability to be evaluated and updated independently within the workflow. RDKit calculations check structural validity, quantify descriptor changes and assess specified structural constraints, while returned observations guide further tool calls. We evaluated low-rank adaptation of the orchestrator for tool-use decisions and failure recovery while leaving specialist weights unchanged. On 3,300 ChEBI-20 test examples, MolCrew achieved 96.4% exact structure recovery, compared with 38.7% for published Atomas-large results. Across eight MoleculeNet datasets evaluated using scaffold splits, mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve was 0.851, compared with 0.770 for published Atomas results. In a recorded evaluation using the unadapted orchestrator, 1,554 of 1,699 requests (91.5%) passed every predefined workflow check. By preserving inspectable links between molecular proposals, model outputs and chemical calculations, MolCrew provides a modular framework for computational candidate assessment and refinement under local data control.

AI.tldr: MolCrew 是一个可本地部署的分子设计系统，由语言模型编排器协调四个独立训练的分子专家模型与 RDKit 计算，完成结构生成、描述、性质预测和迭代编辑，并保持数据本地控制与可检查的化学约束验证。
AI.motivation: 实际分子设计需要生成、性质预测和迭代编辑协同进行，但面临三大挑战：保持分子数据的本地控制、跨任务连接专用模型、验证所提修改满足化学约束。
AI.method: MolCrew 使用语言模型编排器调用四个分别训练的分子专家（从描述生成结构、描述结构、预测生物终点、提出目标导向编辑）及 RDKit 计算；RDKit 检查结构有效性、量化描述符变化并评估结构约束，返回观察结果指导后续工具调用。研究仅对编排器进行低秩适配以提升工具使用决策和失败恢复，专家权重保持不变。
AI.result: 在 3,300 个 ChEBI-20 测试样例上，MolCrew 精确结构恢复率为 96.4%，对比已发表 Atomas-large 的 38.7%；在八个 MoleculeNet 数据集采用 scaffold split 评估，平均 AUROC 为 0.851，对比 Atomas 的 0.770；使用未适配编排器的记录评估中，1,699 个请求有 1,554 个（91.5%）通过全部预定义工作流检查。
AI.conclusion: MolCrew 通过保留分子提议、模型输出与化学计算之间的可检查链接，提供了一个模块化、可在本地数据控制下进行计算候选评估与优化的框架。

title: A Pair-Weighted Reciprocal-Cost Representation of the von Weizs\"acker Functional
summary: We investigate pair-weighted lattice energies constructed from the reciprocal ratio cost $J(x)=\frac{1}{2}(x+x^{-1})-1$ and their connection to the von Weizs\"acker kinetic-energy functional. When the pair weight depends only on the common multiplicative amplitude scale and is quadratic under uniform amplitude rescaling, it takes the form $B(u,v)=Cuv$. For the normalization $C=1$, the weighted edge cost reduces exactly to $\frac{1}{2}(u-v)^2$ for arbitrary positive neighboring amplitudes, without requiring a small-deviation expansion. On a Cartesian lattice, the resulting discrete energy converges to $\frac{1}{2}\int |\nabla u|^2,d\mathbf r$, with leading correction $-\frac{h^2}{24}\sum_k\int(\partial_k^2u)^2,d\mathbf r+O(h^4)$ under the stated regularity conditions. Identifying $u=\sqrt{\rho}$ and restoring the factor $\hbar^2/m$ yields the von Weizs\"acker functional. By contrast, the unweighted ratio cost approaches a scale-invariant log-Dirichlet action and does not have kinetic-energy dimensions. Numerical benchmarks confirm the expected lattice convergence and assess the discretization error in smooth, nodal, cusp, and molecular cases. For $\mathrm{H}_2^+$ densities obtained from aug-cc-pV5Z orbitals, a four-grid least-squares $h^2+h^4$ extrapolation agrees with orbital kinetic energies within $1.5\times10^{-4}$ relative over $R=1$--$6,a_0$. Alternative extrapolations indicate a conservative sensitivity of up to approximately $5\times10^{-4}$. The construction therefore provides a conditional exact discrete representation of the von Weizs\"acker sector rather than an approximation to the complete noninteracting kinetic functional.

AI.tldr: 研究由 reciprocal ratio cost J(x)=1/2(x+x^{-1})-1 构造的 pair-weighted lattice energies 与 von Weizsäcker 动能泛函的联系。证明在权重仅依赖公共乘性振幅尺度且对均匀振幅缩放为二次时，B(u,v)=Cuv；取 C=1，边成本精确化为 1/2(u-v)^2，离散能量收敛到 1/2∫|∇u|^2 d r，取 u=sqrt(rho) 并恢复 hbar^2/m 即得 von Weizsäcker 泛函。
AI.motivation: 为 von Weizsäcker 动能泛函寻找条件精确的离散表示，并澄清 weighted ratio cost 与 unweighted ratio cost 的不同连续极限；目标不是近似完整非相互作用动能泛函，而是精确表示其 von Weizsäcker 扇区。
AI.method: 分析 pair-weighted lattice energy：当 pair weight 仅依赖共同乘性振幅尺度且在均匀振幅重标度下为二次时，权重取 B(u,v)=Cuv。对 C=1，证明加权边成本对任意正相邻振幅精确等于 1/2(u-v)^2，无需小偏离展开。在 Cartesian lattice 上导出离散能量收敛到 1/2∫|∇u|^2 d r，主导修正为 -h^2/24 Σ_k∫(∂_k^2 u)^2 d r + O(h^4)。识别 u=sqrt(rho) 并恢复 hbar^2/m 得到 von Weizsäcker 泛函。数值 benchmark 覆盖光滑、节点、尖点与分子情形；对 H_2^+ 使用 aug-cc-pV5Z orbitals 密度和四网格 least-squares h^2+h^4 extrapolation。
AI.result: 加权边成本精确等于 1/2(u-v)^2 对任意正相邻振幅成立，无需小偏离近似；Cartesian lattice 离散能量按上述 h^2 修正收敛。相对地，unweighted ratio cost 趋近尺度不变 log-Dirichlet action，不具有动能维度。数值 benchmark 确认 lattice convergence 并评估光滑、节点、尖点和分子情形的离散误差。对 H_2^+，在 R=1–6 a_0 范围内，四网格 h^2+h^4 外推与 orbital kinetic energies 的相对偏差在 1.5×10^-4 以内；替代外推显示保守敏感性约 5×10^-4。
AI.conclusion: 该构造给出了 von Weizsäcker 扇区的条件精确离散表示，而非完整非相互作用动能泛函的近似；weighted ratio cost 在特定二次权重下可精确对应 von Weizsäcker 动能，而 unweighted ratio cost 的连续极限是 log-Dirichlet 型作用量。

title: Conformer diversity over quantity in COSMO-RS-based LLE predictions
summary: Accurate prediction of phase equilibria is essential for chemical process design, particularly in systems characterized by complex intermolecular interactions. This work investigates the influence of conformer selection and sigma-profile characteristics on COSMO-RS predictions of liquid-liquid equilibria (LLE), using the tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol (THFA)-methyl isobutyl ketone (MIBK)-water system as a case study. Calculations were performed at the TZVP and TZVPD-FINE levels of theory. While TZVP failed to capture the experimentally observed phase behavior, TZVPD-FINE provided substantially improved predictions. The differences are attributed to the relative importance assigned to less-polar conformers and more-polar conformers capable of hydrogen bonding. Although the TZVPD-FINE calculations reproduced the main experimental trends, the predicted organic-phase composition showed a mean percentage deviation of 5.27%, slightly exceeding the adopted 5% agreement threshold. Investigations using individual conformers demonstrated that predictions can be strongly influenced by conformer selection and that representative conformer ensembles are necessary for reliable results. Further analysis showed that diversity in sigma profiles is more important for predictive accuracy than the total number of conformers. These findings emphasize the importance of carefully selecting conformers when applying COSMO-RS to liquid-liquid equilibria involving phases of contrasting polarity.

AI.tldr: 以THFA-MIBK-水体系为例，研究构象选择与σ-profile特征对COSMO-RS预测液液相平衡的影响，发现TZVPD-FINE显著优于TZVP，且构象集合代表性比构象总数更关键。
AI.motivation: 复杂分子间相互作用体系的相平衡准确预测对化工过程设计至关重要，但COSMO-RS中构象选择及σ-profile特征对液液相平衡预测的影响仍需厘清。
AI.method: 以四氢糠醇（THFA）-甲基异丁基酮（MIBK）-水体系为案例，在TZVP和TZVPD-FINE理论水平下进行COSMO-RS液液相平衡计算，并分析不同构象、构象集合及σ-profile多样性对预测结果的影响。
AI.result: TZVP未能捕捉实验相行为，TZVPD-FINE显著改善预测并再现主要实验趋势；但有机相组成的平均百分比偏差为5.27%，略高于5%的一致性阈值。单构象分析表明预测强烈受构象选择影响，且σ-profile多样性比构象总数更重要。
AI.conclusion: 将COSMO-RS应用于涉及相反极性相的液液相平衡时，必须谨慎选择代表性构象集合，并重视σ-profile多样性以保证预测可靠性。

title: Charge-Dependent Coordination and Redox Energetics of Actinide Fluoride Complexes in Molten Salts
summary: Redox control in molten fluoride salt reactors determines actinide solubility and corrosion of structural alloys, but the role of local fluoride coordination in this control remains poorly understood. We use density functional theory with explicit LiF microsolvation to study the coordination chemistry, intrinsic redox energetics, and fluoride-exchange kinetics of Th(IV), U(IV), and U(III) fluoride complexes. The coordination response to solvation primarily follows the formal charge of the complex rather than the actinide at its center: we find that cationic and neutral complexes gain fluoride ligands, most anionic complexes keep their coordination number, and $4-$ complexes lose fluoride. Coordination number then strongly controls the intrinsic U(IV)/U(III) reduction energy. From CN 4 to CN 7, this energy rises by up to $11$ eV and changes sign; a continuum-solvation estimate opposes this trend and therefore establishes the intrinsic value as an upper bound. Fluoride exchange barriers are low, so redox partners of different charge do not keep the same coordination numbers in solvated clusters. Finally, above a threshold between CN 5 and CN 6, single-reference DFT converges to a ligand-reduced U(III) state inconsistent with formal $5f^3$ occupation, however the physical nature of this is still unresolved. Therefore, local coordination is a primary variable in the prediction of redox behavior in molten actinide-fluoride salts.

AI.tldr: 该文用显式LiF微溶剂化DFT研究Th(IV)、U(IV)、U(III)氟化物配合物的配位化学、本征氧化还原 energetics 与氟交换动力学，指出局部氟配位是熔融锕系氟盐氧化还原行为的关键变量。
AI.motivation: 熔融氟盐反应堆中氧化还原控制决定锕系溶解度和结构合金腐蚀，但局部氟配位在此控制中的作用尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论并结合显式LiF微溶剂化，计算Th(IV)、U(IV)、U(III)氟化物配合物的配位响应、本征U(IV)/U(III)还原能及氟交换动力学。
AI.result: 溶剂化配位响应主要随配合物形式电荷而非中心锕系变化：阳离子和中性配合物获得氟配体，多数阴离子配合物保持配位数，4-配合物失去氟；配位数从CN 4增至CN 7可使本征U(IV)/U(III)还原能升高至多11 eV并改变符号，连续溶剂化估计呈相反趋势，故本征值可视为上限；氟交换势垒低，不同电荷氧化还原伙伴在溶剂化团簇中不保持相同配位数；CN 5与CN 6之间存在阈值，超过后单参考DFT收敛至与形式5f^3占据不一致的配体还原U(III)态，其物理本质仍未解决。
AI.conclusion: 局部配位是预测熔融锕系氟盐中氧化还原行为的主要变量。

title: Steerable Single-step Retrosynthesis with Electron-pushing Discrete Flow Matching and Feynman-Kac Steering
summary: Expert chemists perform retrosynthetic analysis in a strategic manner, where each reaction in a route is employed with a specific purpose, combined with mechanistic reasoning represented as electron-pushing arrows to visualize how bonds are formed or broken via electron redistribution. Yet contemporary single-step retrosynthesis models exhibit neither of these properties: their learned reaction distribution is fixed to that of the training data, and reactions are predicted via de-novo generation of the precursors or molecular graph edits, omitting the electron redistribution that governs the chemical transformations. We introduce Verso MAELLE, the first electron-pushing-based single-step retrosynthetic model, representing disconnections as continuous-time Markov chains (CTMC) comprised of edits in the electron space, and is trainable using a discrete flow matching formulation. Being a generative model, Verso MAELLE is optionally steerable at inference time through the Feynman-Kac (FK) framework, using rewards that promote certain types of disconnections. We show that besides in-distribution learning, Verso MAELLE can be steered toward cyclization reactions which are scaffold-constructive but underrepresented in the training corpus, via a ring-breaking reward. As a proof of concept, we show how the electron-pushing reasoning, learned from patented data, combined with a domino incentivizing reward, could steer Verso MAELLE toward creative and strategic disconnections, demonstrated on the key domino sequence that was used to synthesize Punctaporonin U, a complex natural product of the sesquiterpene family.

AI.tldr: Verso MAELLE 是首个基于电子推动箭头的单步逆合成模型，将断键表示为电子空间中的连续时间马尔可夫链，并用离散流匹配训练；推理时可通过 Feynman-Kac 框架按奖励引导生成。
AI.motivation: 专家逆合成分析具有战略性和机理推理，常以电子推动箭头表示电子重分布与成键/断键；但现有单步逆合成模型反应分布固定于训练数据，且通过前体从头生成或分子图编辑预测反应，缺少支配化学转化的电子重分布表示。
AI.method: 将断键/逆反应表示为电子空间编辑构成的连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC），采用离散流匹配的可生成式建模训练 Verso MAELLE；推理时可选地用 Feynman-Kac 框架和奖励函数进行引导，例如促进特定断键类型或成环反应。
AI.result: 模型除分布内学习外，可通过断环奖励被引导至骨架构建性但训练语料中欠代表的成环反应；概念验证中，从专利数据学到的电子推动推理结合多米诺激励奖励，可引导模型产生有创意且具战略性的断键，并在倍半萜天然产物 Punctaporonin U 的关键多米诺序列上展示。
AI.conclusion: 以电子推动推理为核心的生成式逆合成建模可行，并能通过推理时奖励控制实现战略性、创造性的逆合成断键探索，为超越训练分布的反应预测提供新路径。

title: All Paths All at Once: A Quantum Monte Carlo and Neural Committor Approach to Reaction Pathway Search
summary: Locating competing reaction pathways is difficult when potential-energy gradients are unavailable. Here we present tReax\_expedition, an energy-only approach combining coupled Monte Carlo exploration, stochastic quench labelling and restrained continuation. Exploration identifies connected states, while continuation resolves candidate channels and records sampled chain maxima. Single-search benchmarks on three two-dimensional potentials recovered an intermediate and competing routes without transition-state guesses. For eight of nine gas-phase reactions on GFN2-xTB, sampled chain maxima differed from independently refined saddle energies by less than 0.76~kJ\,mol$^{-1}$. Alanine dipeptide instead revealed incomplete conformational relaxation, showing that route connectivity can persist despite structural and energetic errors. Neural committor learning and local straddling-pair sampling connect the resulting paths to transition-region sampling, although molecular shooting diagnostics indicate limited committor calibration. These results show how energy-only exploration and continuation recover candidate pathways, while distinguishing route connectivity from geometric localization, barrier resolution and finite-temperature transition statistics.

AI.tldr: 提出仅依赖能量的 tReax_expedition，通过耦合 Monte Carlo 探索、随机淬火标记和受限延拓来定位竞争反应路径，并在多个基准中恢复候选通道与近似鞍点能垒。
AI.motivation: 当势能梯度不可用时，传统依赖梯度的过渡态搜索和竞争反应路径定位方法受限，因此需要一种仅利用能量信息即可识别连通状态并解析候选反应通道的方法。
AI.method: tReax_expedition 将耦合 Monte Carlo 探索、随机淬火标记与受限延拓结合：探索阶段识别相互连通的状态，延拓阶段解析候选通道并记录采样链最大值；随后用神经 committor 学习和局部 straddling-pair 采样将所得路径连接到过渡区采样。
AI.result: 在三个二维势能面上，单次搜索无需过渡态初猜即可恢复一个中间体和竞争路径；在 GFN2-xTB 的九个气相反应中，八个反应的采样链最大值与独立精修鞍点能量相差小于 0.76 kJ·mol⁻¹。丙氨酸二肽案例显示构象弛豫不充分，说明即使存在结构和能量误差，路径连通性仍可能保留；分子 shooting 诊断则表明 committor 校准有限。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，仅依赖能量的探索与延拓能够恢复候选反应路径，但需区分路径连通性、几何定位、能垒分辨率和有限温度过渡统计等不同层面的信息。

title: Complete Donor-Set Guidance for Frozen Diffusion Docking Models
summary: Metalloprotein docking requires a ligand pose to satisfy both global pocket fit and the identity and geometry of metal-coordinating atoms. General-purpose diffusion docking models do not explicitly condition generation on externally specified complete ligand donor sets, and their predicted poses can exhibit incorrect metal-donor relationships. Metal-aware models address coordination during training and generation; here we ask whether external donor information can correct already-trained general-purpose models without retraining. We propose Complete-Identity Contract Guidance (CICG), which applies a supplied complete donor set through translation, rotation, and torsion updates, and Historical Contract Transfer (HCT), which supplies donor identities from earlier complexes at compatible receptor sites. We compare HCT with trajectory-local controls retaining the historical donor count with or without elemental composition. On 86 assessable HCT-covered queries, HCT-guided CICG increases frozen-confidence-selected joint success from 21.5% to 36.6% on SurfDock and from 25.0% to 34.9% on DiffDock-L. The joint criterion requires correct global ligand placement, complete native donor recovery, coordination geometry, preserved stereochemistry, and absence of fatal receptor clashes. Composition-matched guidance reaches 33.14% and 34.30%, leaving the additional benefit of fixed historical membership unresolved. Our results therefore support donor-set guidance as a conditional correction for frozen docking models, while identifying donor-source reliability and physical-quality preservation as the main barriers to broader use.

AI.tldr: 提出无需重训的完整身份契约引导（CICG）与历史契约迁移（HCT），用外部供体集合校正冻结的通用扩散对接模型在金属蛋白对接中的金属配位关系。
AI.motivation: 通用扩散对接模型未显式以外部完整配体供体集合为条件，预测姿态可能出现错误的金属-供体关系；本文探究能否在不重训的情况下，用外部供体信息纠正已训练模型。
AI.method: CICG通过平移、旋转和扭转更新将给定完整供体集合施加到生成姿态；HCT从相容受体位点的早期复合物提供供体身份。在86个可评估HCT覆盖查询上，与保留历史供体数量及有无元素组成的轨迹局部对照比较，并以冻结置信度选择联合成功姿态。
AI.result: HCT引导CICG将冻结置信度选择的联合成功率从SurfDock的21.5%提高到36.6%，从DiffDock-L的25.0%提高到34.9%；联合标准包括全局配体放置、完整天然供体恢复、配位几何、立体化学保持和无致命受体冲突。组成匹配引导达33.14%和34.30%，固定历史成员身份的额外收益尚未确定。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持供体集合引导作为冻结对接模型的条件校正，但供体来源可靠性和物理质量保持是更广泛使用的主要障碍。

title: Isothermal-Isobaric Molecular Dynamics with a Foundation Interatomic Potential in LAMMPS across NVIDIA and Intel GPUs
summary: Foundation machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) offer one model for many chemistries, but their deep, globally coupled architectures do not fit the spatial decomposition that scales classical and short-ranged MLIPs. We present pair_style uma, a LAMMPS pair style that evaluates the Universal Model for Atoms (UMA) through LibTorch on NVIDIA and Intel GPUs from a single source tree. It reimplements FairChem's edge-sharded graph parallelism in C++ over exported TorchScript modules, with one MPI rank per device, NCCL or oneCCL collectives, and the whole energy and force path in double precision. The strain-gradient virial is carried through the exported modules and the cross-device reductions, so that fix npt runs on both vendors' hardware. We measure NPT capacity and cost on one 4xA100-40GB node, one 8xH200 node, and one 12-tile Intel node, and on up to 32 Intel nodes. Without activation checkpointing, one node holds NaCl cells of about 8,000 atoms (A100, 0.21 ns/day), 22,000 atoms (Intel, 0.10 ns/day), and 47,000 atoms (H200, 0.16 ns/day). Graph parallelism raises the capacity of a single device by 8.0x on H200 and 4.6x on A100. Across nodes, capacity grows to about 779,000 atoms on 32 Intel nodes, with a slower speed at 0.007 ns/day. On H200 and A100, a FLOP count of FairChem's graph-parallel predictor gives lower bounds of 31% and 51% of FP64 peak. From one omat checkpoint and with no refit, nine 100 ps NPT heating ramps (NaCl, equiatomic Pt-Ru, and equiatomic (HfNbTaTiZr)N, on all three node types) ran to completion.

AI.tldr: 提出 LAMMPS 的 pair_style uma，通过 LibTorch 在 NVIDIA 和 Intel GPU 上运行 UMA 基础机器学习原子间势，并实现跨设备图并行与双精度 NPT 模拟。
AI.motivation: 基础 MLIP 可用一个模型覆盖多种化学体系，但其深度、全局耦合架构不适合经典势和短程 MLIP 所依赖的空间分解，难以直接扩展到大规模并行模拟。
AI.method: 该工作将 FairChem 的边分片图并行用 C++ 在导出的 TorchScript 模块上重实现；每个设备一个 MPI rank，使用 NCCL 或 oneCCL 集合通信；能量和力全路径采用双精度；应变梯度 virial 贯穿导出模块和跨设备归约，从而支持两种硬件上的 fix npt。
AI.result: 在 4xA100-40GB、8xH200 和 12-tile Intel 节点上测试：无激活检查点时单节点分别可容纳约 8,000、47,000 和 22,000 个 NaCl 原子，速度为 0.21、0.16 和 0.10 ns/day；图并行将单设备容量在 H200 和 A100 上分别提升 8.0x 和 4.6x；32 个 Intel 节点可扩展到约 779,000 原子，但速度降至 0.007 ns/day；H200/A100 上 FairChem 图并行预测器的 FLOP 计数给出 FP64 峰值 31%/51% 的下界；同一 omat checkpoint 无需重拟合即完成 9 条 100 ps NPT 升温模拟，覆盖 NaCl、等原子 Pt-Ru 和等原子 (HfNbTaTiZr)N，并在三类节点上运行。
AI.conclusion: pair_style uma 使基础 MLIP UMA 能在 LAMMPS 中跨 NVIDIA 与 Intel 硬件进行大规模、双精度且支持 NPT 的模拟，展示了图并行提升单设备和多节点容量的可行性，同时揭示了跨节点扩展时速度下降的代价。

title: Accurate representation of the continuum orbital in a Gaussian basis set: application to Auger decay rates
summary: Many processes in chemistry and physics, such as autoionization, photoionization, or electron-impact collisions, involve unbound electrons. Despite their importance, theoretical methods for modeling continuum electrons remain significantly less developed than those for purely bound electronic states. Here we present a novel approach for treating continuum electrons within Gaussian-based quantum chemistry. The method represents continuum orbital in a discrete basis of standard Gaussian-type orbitals (GTOs), where the continuum wave function is obtained by solving the Lippmann-Schwinger equation with proper boundary conditions using an analytical representation of the Green's function in an auxiliary GTO basis set. The resulting continuum orbital is multicentered and multichannel, providing a rigorous description of scattering states. As an initial application of the new methodology, we compute Auger decay rates for several atomic and molecular systems, including Ne, H$_2$O, CO$_2$, and Ar. We demonstrate a consistent improvement of the results with increasing the quality of the continuum representation. We show also that higher-order electron-correlation effects in the bound domain are essential for an accurate treatment of satellite transitions. The present formalism therefore provides a systematically improvable Gaussian-based framework for continuum-electron problems that is fully compatible with standard quantum chemistry methods.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种在 Gaussian 量子化学框架内处理连续电子的新方法，并用于计算原子和分子的 Auger 衰变速率。
AI.motivation: 化学物理中自电离、光电离和电子碰撞等过程涉及非束缚电子，但连续电子理论方法的发展明显落后于纯束缚态方法。
AI.method: 用标准 Gaussian 型轨道（GTO）的离散基表示连续轨道；通过辅助 GTO 基中 Green 函数的解析表示，求解满足正确边界条件的 Lippmann-Schwinger 方程，得到多中心、多通道的严格散射态描述。
AI.result: 对 Ne、H2O、CO2 和 Ar 等体系计算 Auger 衰变速率，结果表明随连续态表示质量提高结果一致改善；束缚域中的高阶电子相关效应对准确处理卫星跃迁至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 该形式提供了一种可系统改进、与标准量子化学方法完全兼容的 Gaussian 框架，用于连续电子问题。
